name: Harbour Bridge and Chapel Islet composition

approval.note: W0 design proposal only; not drawn, gated, approved or available for placement.

variants.note: One authored bridge/islet skyline with route and water clearances.

story.lore: Give the ria its two high arches, island footing and mast-clear passage as an unmistakable city landmark.

todo: Purpose: Give the ria its two high arches, island footing and mast-clear passage as an unmistakable city landmark.
Visual brief: Two pale high arches over dark water, real piers on Chapel Islet and massive abutments at each shore; the little chapel stays subordinate to the bridge silhouette.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 36x16 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Scale: custom composition envelope only; arch height is set against the authored vessel/mast rather than an arbitrary repeated arch sprite.
Rule proposal: clear vertical passage for the intended mast, dry bridge route above, and physically supported island piers; no invisible route connection through the water.
Uniqueness: its two arches and Chapel Islet are site identity; stone courses, railing and steps are shared.
